items.description: The interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS carries a chemical clue to conditions in the planetary system of its origin, locked away long before it reached our sun. items.title: Scientists discover a surprising brain benefit of eating peanuts every day
items.description: A surprising new study suggests that eating peanuts every day could help support brain health and memory in older adults.
